usage: A small tropical fruit with sweet, juicy flesh
Very popular in Cantonese-speaking regions, especially in summer
Often eaten fresh and sold by weight rather than by piece
Commonly described by sweetness and freshness
Frequently mentioned in market and seasonal food conversations
